name: InspectorSlider
label: Inspector slider
description: One-row slider for inspector panels, where the whole bar is the control and its fill is the value.

props.name: label
props.description: The setting's name, drawn inside the bar on the left. Also the range's accessible name.

props.name: value
props.description: Current value (controlled). Leave unset and use `defaultValue` for an uncontrolled slider.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Starting value for an uncontrolled slider. Defaults to `min`.

props.name: step
props.description: Step increment. Also sets how many decimals the reading shows (0.02 reads "0.50").

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the reading on the right, and the value a screen reader announces. Defaults to the step's precision.

props.name: size
props.description: Component size, matching Button: `default` is 40px tall, `compact` 32px (not the native character-width `size` attribute).

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Convenience callback receiving the numeric value directly.
Fires alongside `onChange`, which keeps the standard React event signature.

props.name: locale
props.description: The BCP 47 locale the reading is written in when no `format` is given, such as `de-DE` (`0,5`). Defaults to the nearest LocaleProvider's, else `en-US`.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes, applied to the bar rather than the <input>.
